vb_textbox.text: To a certain degree I think you should try and trust your own judgement as you try to detect a pattern.The colours come in four pairs (purple/pink, brown/blue, red/green, orange/yellow) and one of each colour pair seems to be dominant at anyone time. This seems to cycle differently for each colour pair. There also do seem to be times of transition when both colours of a pair score low. I tended to score most of my points when a set of colours stayed dominant for an extended period. I think best just to go along with the flow during these periods and stick to a dominant colour in each pair.I'm not sure if the baskets change anything. Possibly they do but it was impossible to determine in the time given.I think the best use of time is to reinforce the dominant colours in your mind between the gnome picks. Also thinking too much about what the pattern is led to me timing out on several occasions. This could have a bigger determination on your overall score than getting the right selections if it happens too often.Have fun!
